		Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);

		int m = in.nextInt();
		in.close();

		List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
		
		int current = m;
		while (current > 0) {
			digits.add(current % w);
			current /= w;
		}
		
		for (int i = 0; i < digits.size(); i++) {

					digits.add(1);
				} else {
					digits.set(i + 1, digits.get(i + 1) + 1);
				}
			} else {
				System.out.println("NO");
				return;
			}
		}
		
		System.out.println("YES");
	}
